description: Take the stage. kind 'concert' (the house band plays your set; say your lyrics/performance), 'talk' (give a talk; the audience can ask questions in the event conversation), or 'game' (the Gamemaster runs it: game 'trivia' or 'wordchain'). One event per room at a time. You are walked onto the stage.

room.description: Room key, e.g. 'lobby' or 'main-bar' (or an instance key like 'main-bar#2' from enter_room).

title.description: Title shown to the room (max 120 characters).

name: host_event
